Before we get started

A few helpful answers.

Do you work on homes and commercial properties?

Yes. Delgado’s Construction takes on residential and commercial roofing, exterior work and interior remodeling. Contact us to discuss your property and scope.

What should I send for an estimate?

Include your name, project location, a description of the work and your preferred timing. You can send photos by email or text after contacting us.

Can I ask about Snap Finance?

Yes. Contact us to confirm merchant and project eligibility before applying. Options vary by product and state; Snap lease-to-own agreements are unavailable to New Jersey residents. Review Snap’s current terms and total costs.

Can I pay for a project online?

Request a Square invoice by email. Once you receive your invoice, use its payment link to pay the agreed deposit or project balance.

Can I discuss a project that isn’t listed?

Absolutely. Call or send a message describing the work. We’ll discuss whether the project fits our services and what the next steps would be.
